SELECT COALESCE(SUM(minutes), 0) FROM time_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ended_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT l.user_id AS user_id, SUM(l.minutes) AS total_minutes FROM time_log l WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND l.started_at >= #{from} AND l.started_at < #{to}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t JOIN project_member pm ON pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none' WHERE t.id = l.task_id)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.id = l.task_id AND t.req_id = #{reqId})
GROUP BY l.user_id
SELECT user_id AS user_id, SUM(minutes) AS total_minutes FROM time_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ended_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id
SELECT task_id, SUM(minutes) AS total_minutes FROM time_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ended_at IS NOT NULL AND task_id IN #{tid} GROUP BY task_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.minutes), 0) AS total_all, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.started_at >= #{from} AND l.started_at < #{to} THEN l.minutes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS week_all, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.user_id = #{userId} THEN l.minutes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_mine, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.started_at >= #{from} AND l.started_at < #{to} THEN l.minutes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS week_mine FROM time_log l WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.ended_at IS NOT NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t JOIN project_member pm ON pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none' WHERE t.id = l.task_id)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.id = l.task_id AND t.req_id = #{reqId})

SELECT user_id AS user_id, DATE_SUB(DATE(started_at), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(started_at) DAY) AS week_start, SUM(minutes) AS total_minutes FROM time_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND minutes IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= #{from} AND started_at < #{to} AND task_id IN #{tid} GROUP BY user_id, week_start ORDER BY MIN(started_at), user_id

SELECT tl.user_id AS user_id, DATE(COALESCE(tl.ended_at, tl.started_at)) AS day, SUM(tl.minutes) AS total_minutes FROM time_log tl INNER JOIN task t ON t.id = tl.task_id AND t.workspace_id = tl.workspace_id WHERE tl.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND tl.minutes IS NOT NULL AND t.req_id = #{reqId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tl.user_id, DATE(COALESCE(tl.ended_at, tl.started_at))
mapper.sql: SELECT t.id AS taskId, t.title, t.item_type AS itemType, t.owner, t.start_date AS startDate, t.due_date AS dueDate, t.estimate_minutes AS estimateMinutes, t.board_column AS boardColumn, CASE WHEN r.first_released_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(COALESCE(tl.ended_at, tl.started_at)) > r.first_released_at THEN 'post' ELSE 'mvp' END AS phase, SUM(tl.minutes) AS minutes FROM time_log tl INNER JOIN task t ON t.id = tl.task_id AND t.workspace_id = tl.workspace_id INNER JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE tl.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND tl.minutes IS NOT NULL AND t.req_id = #{reqId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND tl.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY t.id, t.title, t.item_type, t.owner, t.start_date, t.due_date, t.estimate_minutes, t.board_column, phase
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.phase = 'mvp' THEN g.minutes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mvp_minutes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN g.phase = 'post' THEN g.minutes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS post_minutes FROM () g

SELECT g.taskId, g.title, g.itemType, g.owner, g.startDate, g.dueDate, g.estimateMinutes, g.boardColumn, g.phase, g.minutes FROM () g ORDER BY (g.phase = 'post'), g.taskId LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
